description: Mutes or unmutes one listing for the caller on XP -- 'hide this one', 'stop showing me that', 'unmute that listing'. Muting changes only the caller's view: the listing stays open, offers on it stand, and the seller and other buyers see no change. Muted listings are left out of list_open_listings. Sets the state passed rather than toggling, so repeating a call is safe. Requires sign-in.

listing_identifier.description: Listing identifier from list_open_listings or get_open_listing.

muted.description: True to mute (hide it from the user's marketplace feed), False to unmute.

name: mute_listing
